messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to rewrite the streaming examples that switch from sync generator to async iterator (py/ts/go). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
Ben: Nice. Can you add migration notes for retries+paginated streams? People keep losing last-cursor semantics.
Maya: Yeah — planning to add a "Migration" section showing old pattern -> new pattern for cursors and backoff. Draft snippet for Python below:
Maya: ```python
# old sync pattern
for chunk in client.stream(...):
    process(chunk)

# new async pattern
async for chunk in client.stream_async(...):
    process(chunk)
```
Chris: Needs concrete backoff sample. Suggest using tenacity in python example so users don't reimplement.
Maya: Good call. I'll add a retry wrapper and explicit cursor TTL note.
Sam: For TS, also show how to convert event-stream parsing to async iterator with for await...of. I can drop a patch.
Sam: ```ts
// old
client.stream(params).on('data', handler)

// new
for await (const ev of client.streamAsync(params)) {
  handler(ev)
}
```
Ben: Ping @Li for Go snippet — streaming iterators are trickier; need to show ctx cancellation and ReadAll pattern.
Li: I'll add a small io.Reader-style example and emphasize defer cancel/ctx timeout.
DocsBot: deploy-preview published at https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/842 — snapshot includes snippets.
Maya: Can reviewers call out any API surface mismatches? I changed method names in docs to stream_async to reflect SDK rename, but SDK PR uses streamAsync in TS/Go. Should be consistent.
Chris: Align to SDK naming. If SDK uses streamAsync for TS and Go, use stream_async for Python — add a note mapping names.
Ben: I'll do a quick pass on wording + link TODOs. If no objections, merge by EOD.
Maya: Thanks — adding TODO checklist in PR description. @everyone please review when you have a mo :heart:
